Crawl with browser mode 'always' follows links using browser rendering

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"},\"max_depth\":1,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.crawl_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result)
```
